name: pet-village
description: A transparent desktop village for live Herdr agents

scripts.lint: npm run lint:eslint && npm run lint:python && npm run lint:shell && npm run lint:actions && npm run lint:toml && npm run lint:rust
scripts.format: prettier --write . && ruff format scripts .pi/skills/pet-sprite-apng/scripts && shfmt -w scripts/*.sh && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && taplo format
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && ruff format --check scripts .pi/skills/pet-sprite-apng/scripts && shfmt -d scripts/*.sh && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check && taplo format --check
scripts.check:quality: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.check: npm run check:quality && npm run check:lines && npm run check:flow && npm run check:focus && npm run check:interactions && npm run check:preferences && npm run build && cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
